component.name: OntoCode Studio
component.summary: OWL ontology editor with reasoning and visualization

description.p: OntoCode Studio is a modular environment for building, editing, managing, and collaborating on OWL ontologies. It bundles a graph-based ontology editor, reasoning support, and visualization tools into a single desktop application, backed by a local Apache Jena Fuseki triple store and MongoDB instance.

ul.li: Visual and text-based OWL/RDF/Turtle ontology editing
Local-first storage with no required network account

screenshot.caption: Real-time collaboration on a shared ontology

description.p: Individuals List, Resizable Panel, Editable IRI & Report Panel.

ul.li: Fixed the individuals list getting stuck at 50 after adding more or merging with more than 50 individuals.
Entities panel can now be resized by dragging its edge.
Class Editor: you can now edit a class's IRI, similar to Protégé.
Report panel now updates its wording correctly when switching to "Feature Request".
